title: Usage of EMBL2checklists
author: Michael Grünstäudl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v6me9c6
materials: Artemis: Sequence visualization and annotation. Bioinformatics

steps.title: Annotate DNA sequences
steps.instruction: Add sequence features and feature qualifiers to each DNA sequence using INSDC-compatible feature table keywords.

substeps.instruction: Use one of the following software tools: Geneious, Artemis, or DnaSP.

steps.title: Save sequences as flat file
steps.instruction: Save multiple DNA sequences of the same barcoding marker as a single, multi-sequence flat file in EMBL or GenBank format.

substeps.instruction: Use Geneious, Artemis, or DnaSP to export the annotated sequences.

steps.title: Install EMBL2checklists
steps.instruction: Install the EMBL2checklists software via pip (Python Package Index).

substeps.instruction: On Linux and MacOS, run the command: (sudo) pip2 install EMBL2checklists

steps.title: Convert flat file to checklist
steps.instruction: Convert the EMBL- or GenBank-formatted flat file into the Webin checklist file format using EMBL2checklists.

substeps.instruction: To use the command-line interface (CLI), execute: EMBL2checklists_CLI \ -i example/input/example_trnK_matK.embl \ -o example/temp/example_trnK_matK.tsv \ -c trnK_matK \ -e no

steps.title: Upload checklist to ENA
steps.instruction: Upload the resulting checklist to the sequence section of ENA using the interactive route of the Webin submission system.
